title: Harden lifecycle safety and command evidence
summary: Fail-closed close readiness, durable launch leases, and strict critical-command evidence.
reason: Prevent duplicate execution, unsafe close, and unproven mutation outcomes.
behavior_before: Unknown close state and non-durable lifecycle evidence could be treated too permissively.
behavior_after: Unknown state blocks close; critical commands require durable accepted and terminal evidence.
rollback_plan: Revert the lease/handler policy together; retain lifecycle state for reconciliation before any downgrade.
notes: Fail-closed close policy, durable launch lease, and strict pre/post mutation command evidence.
